The built-in planner and GPX inspection run on this device. Downloading a region connects to its static file host, which receives connection metadata such as your IP address and requested files.

Sharing is optional. Sharing a route sends its coordinates, names and planning details to the sharing service you choose. Anyone with an unlisted route or outing link can view its shared contents.

Location sharing starts only when you choose Start and grant permission. Android sharing can continue while the app is minimized or the screen is locked, with a visible notification. The sharing service receives your precise position, accuracy, capture time and available sensor information. It stores a current position and a short replay of recent updates so viewers can reconnect; this does not create an activity track.

Stop ends publication and requests removal of the current position. If clearing cannot be confirmed, that position may remain visible until expiry. Stop cannot recall information already seen by others.

Remember and Save for offline use are optional. Use Forget, Clear offline data and the region removal controls to remove the corresponding local copies. Native sharing keeps at most one encrypted participant session and one latest pending fix. Exported files are controlled by the storage or app you selected.

The sharing service controls expiry, deletion and backups. Owners can delete shared content with their secret owner controls; participants can leave an outing. Deleting the app does not delete shared server content or copies held by other people.

The app has no advertising or analytics integration. The selected sharing service and static file host may process connection metadata under their own policies.
